mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_cost_ledger (entry_no, entry_type, cost_kind, request_id, trace_id, user_id, agent_id, knowledge_base_id, business_scene, provider, model_name, quantity, amount, currency, pricing_version, remark, occurred_at) VALUES (#{entryNo}, #{entryType}, #{costKind}, #{requestId}, #{traceId}, #{userId}, #{agentId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{businessScene}, #{provider}, #{modelName}, #{quantity}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{pricingVersion}, #{remark}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, entry_no, entry_type, cost_kind, request_id, trace_id, user_id, agent_id, knowledge_base_id, business_scene, provider, model_name, quantity, amount, currency, pricing_version, remark, occurred_at, created_at FROM ai_cost_ledger ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, entry_no, entry_type, cost_kind, request_id, trace_id, user_id, agent_id, knowledge_base_id, business_scene, provider, model_name, quantity, amount, currency, pricing_version, remark, occurred_at, created_at FROM ai_cost_ledger WHERE request_id = #{requestId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT entry_type AS entryType, cost_kind AS costKind, COUNT(*) AS entryCount, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM ai_cost_ledger WHERE cost_kind = #{costKind} AND occurred_at >= #{from} AND occurred_at < #{to} GROUP BY entry_type, cost_kind ORDER BY amount DESC
